## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat, and stolid youth with a round, expressionless face. He also has a broad, freckled countenance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

A big, round-faced youth of twenty, Billy Andrews is stolid, good-natured, and perpetually smiling, though he suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts and extreme shyness. Despite his mortal fear of social invitations and fine gatherings, he has no bad habits, is a great worker, and is driven by a strong desire to marry [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v3 ch.Proposal P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## History

Billy Andrews drove [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) to and from a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where he transported them home under the moonlight. Later, his father gave him the upper farm in his own name. Through his sister [Jane](../character/jane.md), the shy Billy delivered an unromantic marriage proposal by proxy to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), which she declined. By the time [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after attending college, Billy had married someone else.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P7](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P8](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P11](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane.md)

Billy and [Jane](../character/jane.md) are brother and sister living in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). While their relationship is primarily noted through shared community events, [Jane](../character/jane.md) maintains a close tie to her brother's personal life. Their familial connection remains steady as both grow up, with [Jane](../character/jane.md) remaining aware of his personal milestones, such as his eventual marriage.

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P27](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0027), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane](../character/jane.md) acts as a sister and social intermediary for her shy brother, Billy. He occasionally provides transportation for [Jane](../character/jane.md) and her friends, such as driving them to and from a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). Their relationship faces minor tension when [Jane](../character/jane.md) delivers a proxy marriage proposal to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) on Billy's behalf; after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses, [Jane](../character/jane.md) accepts the rejection with slight coldness, though she practical-mindedly notes that Billy will likely pursue [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) instead.

- Sibling of — brother and sister driving together to a concert  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 ch.Proposal P13](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0013)</sub>

### [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--nettie-blewett.md)

Nettie becomes Billy's wife during the period [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is away at college. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects a proxy marriage proposal from Billy, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) predicts that he will move on to Nettie instead. This prediction comes to fruition shortly after, with the community noting their marriage by the time [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

- Spouse of — married (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
